library(shiny) library(leaflet) library(dplyr) library(sf) library(DT) library(ggplot2) library(plotly) # Load geo reference file GEO_REF <- read.csv2("./shp/GEO_REF_EUROPE_PLUS_US.csv") GEO_REF$NAME <- ifelse(GEO_REF$ENGLISHNAME != "", paste0(GEO_REF$NAME, " (", GEO_REF$ENGLISHNAME, ")"), GEO_REF$NAME) GEO_REF$ENGLISHNAME <- NULL # Adjusting shape file for continental Europa to include correct region names contEurope <- st_read("./shp/continentalEurope.shp") contEurope_df <- st_drop_geometry(contEurope) contEurope_df <- contEurope_df %>% left_join(GEO_REF, by = c("NUTS_ID" = "ID")) contEurope_df <- contEurope_df %>% rename(location_NAME = NAME) contEurope_df$location_NAME <- ifelse(contEurope_df$NUTS_ID %in% c("UKI5", "UKI6", "UKI7"), "Outer London", contEurope_df$location_NAME) contEurope_df$location_NAME <- ifelse(contEurope_df$NUTS_ID %in% c("UKI3", "UKI4"), "Inner London", contEurope_df$location_NAME) contEurope_df$location_NAME <- ifelse(contEurope_df$NUTS_ID %in% c("XKO"), "Kosovo", contEurope_df$location_NAME) contEurope_df$location_NAME <- ifelse(contEurope_df$NUTS_ID %in% c("MDA"), "Moldova", contEurope_df$location_NAME) contEurope$NUTS_NAME <- contEurope_df$location_NAME contEurope$NUTS_ID <- ifelse(contEurope$NUTS_ID %in% c("UKI3", "UKI4"), "UKI1", contEurope$NUTS_ID) contEurope$NUTS_ID <- ifelse(contEurope$NUTS_ID %in% c("UKI5", "UKI6", "UKI7"), "UKI2", contEurope$NUTS_ID) # Load GDP data gdpdata <- read.csv2("./historicalGDPs_augmented_dataset_v3.csv") # library(customFunctions) # gdpdata$name2 <- vlookup(gdpdata$location, GEO_REF) # gdpdata$location_name <- ifelse(is.na(gdpdata$name2), gdpdata$location_name, gdpdata$name2) # gdpdata$name2 <- NULL # write.csv2(gdpdata, "./historicalGDPs_augmented_dataset.csv", row.names=F) gdpdata$location_name <- ifelse(gdpdata$location == "UKI1", "Inner London", gdpdata$location_name) gdpdata$location_name <- ifelse(gdpdata$location == "UKI2", "Outer London", gdpdata$location_name) gdpdata <- gdpdata %>% mutate_at(vars(year, GDPpc, GDPpc_lower, GDPpc_upper), as.numeric) gdpdata$full_location_name <- paste(gdpdata$location, gdpdata$location_name, sep=" - ") # Load shp files USAMSA <- st_read("./shp/US_MSAs.shp") USAMSA$GEOID <- paste(paste0("US", USAMSA$GEOID)) CAN <- read_sf("./shp/CAN_MSAs.shp") CAN$CMAUID <- paste(paste0("CN", CAN$CMAUID)) world <- st_read("./shp/world-administrative-boundaries.shp") specials <- st_read("./shp/specialcountries.shp") specials <- bind_rows(specials, subset(contEurope, NUTS_ID == "PL21")) specials$ID_0 <- ifelse(specials$NUTS_ID == "PL21", "POL", specials$ID_0) specials$COUNTRY <- ifelse(specials$NUTS_ID == "PL21", "Poland (only Krakow)", specials$COUNTRY) specials <- specials %>% select(ID_0, COUNTRY, geometry) colnames(specials) <- c("iso3", "name", "geometry") specials$iso3 <- ifelse(specials$iso3 == "NLD_1", "NLD", specials$iso3) specials$iso3 <- ifelse(specials$iso3 == "ENG", "GBR", specials$iso3) specials$iso3 <- ifelse(specials$iso3 == "N_ITA", "ITA", specials$iso3) ui <- fluidPage( titlePanel("Historical GDP per capita levels"), tags$head( tags$style(HTML(" .bottom-logos { position: fixed; bottom: 0; left: 0; z-index: 1000; background-color: white; padding: 10px; box-shadow: 0 -2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); margin-left: 10px; } .bottom-logos img { margin-left: 10px; } .explanatory-text { margin: 20px 0; padding: 10px; background-color: #f9f9f9; border-left: 5px solid #007bff; } .sidebar-container { position: relative; } @media (max-width: 600px) { .bottom-logos { display: none; } } ")) ), tags$div( class = "explanatory-text", HTML("

This website provides an interactive tool to explore the augmented dataset of historical GDP per capita levels introduced in:

Koch, P., Stojkoski, V. & C.A. Hidalgo (2024). Augmenting the availability of historical GDP per capita estimates through machine learning. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences (PNAS).

We introduce a machine learning method to estimate the GDP per capita of dozens of countries and hundreds of regions in Europe and North America for the past 700 years starting from data on the places of birth, death, and occupations of hundreds of thousands of historical figures. We publish our out-of-sample estimates together with the collected source data on countries and regions (see sources in the manuscript) in a comprehensive dataset comprising 5,700 observations (1,574 source data observations, and 4,126 out-of-sample estimates). For the out-of-sample estimates, we provide 90 percent confidence intervals.

Click here to download the data and code from GitHub.

This work is licensed under CC BY 4.0

") ), sidebarLayout( sidebarPanel( div(class = "sidebar-container", sliderInput("year", "Select year for maps:", min = min(gdpdata$year, na.rm = TRUE), max = max(gdpdata$year, na.rm = TRUE), value = 1750, step = 50, sep = ""), actionButton("toggle_map", "Switch to Country Map"), tags$div(style = "margin-top: 10px;"), actionButton("focus_europe", "Zoom on Europe"), actionButton("focus_north_america", "Zoom on North America"), tags$div(style = "margin-top: 20px;"), selectizeInput("regions", "Select regions and countries for line plot:", choices = unique(gdpdata$full_location_name), multiple = TRUE), actionButton("plot", "Plot selected regions and countries"), tags$div( class = "bottom-logos", tags$img(src = "CCL.png", height = "35px"), tags$img(src = "EA.png", height = "28px"), tags$img(src = "UToulouse.png", height = "35px"), tags$img(src = "Corvinus.png", height = "35px") ) ) ), mainPanel( div( tabsetPanel(id = "mainTabset", tabPanel("Map", leafletOutput("map")), tabPanel("Line Plot", plotlyOutput("linePlot")) ), style = "margin-bottom: 20px;" ), conditionalPanel( condition = "input.mainTabset == 'Map'", DTOutput("data") ) ) ) ) server <- function(input, output, session) { # Track the current map state: regional or country map_state <- reactiveVal("regional") # Update selectizeInput choices dynamically on server side updateSelectizeInput(session, 'regions', choices = unique(gdpdata$full_location_name), server = TRUE) filtered_data <- reactive({ gdpdata %>% filter(year == input$year) }) # Reactive expression to render the map based on the current map state render_map <- reactive({ if (map_state() == "regional") { render_regional_map() } else { render_country_map() } }) render_regional_map <- function() { gdp_year <- filtered_data() %>% mutate(log_GDPpc = log10(GDPpc)) contEurope_merged <- contEurope %>% left_join(gdp_year, by = c("NUTS_ID" = "location")) USAMSA_merged <- USAMSA %>% left_join(gdp_year, by = c("GEOID" = "location")) CAN_merged <- CAN %>% left_join(gdp_year, by = c("CMAUID" = "location")) pal <- colorNumeric(palette = colorRampPalette(c("#DCEDC8", "#064300"))(100), domain = log10(range(gdp_year$GDPpc, na.rm = TRUE)), na.color = "transparent") legend_values <- seq(min(gdp_year$GDPpc, na.rm = TRUE), max(gdp_year$GDPpc, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 5) legend_labels <- format(legend_values, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE) legend_pal <- colorNumeric(palette = colorRampPalette(c("#DCEDC8", "#064300"))(100), domain = log10(legend_values), na.color = "transparent") leafletProxy("map", data = contEurope_merged) %>% clearShapes() %>% clearControls() %>% addPolygons(data = contEurope_merged, fillColor = ~pal(log_GDPpc), fillOpacity = ~ifelse(is.na(GDPpc), 0, 1), color = "black", weight = 0.8, popup = ~paste("Location Name:", NUTS_NAME, "
", "Location ID:", NUTS_ID, "
", "GDP per Capita:", GDPpc, "
", "Year:", year, "
", "Source:", flag)) %>% addPolygons(data = USAMSA_merged, fillColor = ~pal(log_GDPpc), fillOpacity = ~ifelse(is.na(GDPpc), 0, 1), color = "black", weight = 0.8, popup = ~paste("Location Name:", NAME, "
", "Location ID:", GEOID, "
", "GDP per Capita:", GDPpc, "
", "Year:", year, "
", "Source:", flag)) %>% addPolygons(data = CAN_merged, fillColor = ~pal(log_GDPpc), fillOpacity = ~ifelse(is.na(GDPpc), 0, 1), color = "black", weight = 0.8, popup = ~paste("Location Name:", CMANAME, "
", "Location ID:", CMAUID, "
", "GDP per Capita:", GDPpc, "
", "Year:", year, "
", "Source:", flag)) %>% addLegend(pal = legend_pal, values = log10(legend_values), labels = legend_labels, labFormat = labelFormat(transform = function(x) round(10^x, digits = 0)), title = "GDP per capita (2011$)", position = "bottomright") } render_country_map <- function() { gdp_year <- filtered_data() %>% mutate(log_GDPpc = log10(GDPpc)) if(input$year <= 1700){ world_adj <- subset(world, iso3 != "GBR" & iso3 != "NLD" & iso3 != "POL" & iso3 != "ITA") world_adj <- bind_rows(world_adj, specials[specials$iso3 %in% c("GBR", "WAL", "SCO", "NLD", "NLD_2", "POL", "POL_2", "ITA", "S_ITA"),]) } if(input$year %in% c(1750, 1800)){ world_adj <- subset(world, iso3 != "NLD" & iso3 != "POL" & iso3 != "ITA") world_adj <- bind_rows(world_adj, specials[specials$iso3 %in% c("NLD", "NLD_2", "POL", "POL_2", "ITA", "S_ITA"),]) } if(input$year == 1850){ world_adj <- subset(world, iso3 != "POL" & iso3 != "ITA" & iso3 != "CZE" & iso3 != "SVK") world_adj <- bind_rows(world_adj, specials[specials$iso3 %in% c("POL", "POL_2", "ITA", "S_ITA", "CSK"),]) } if(input$year %in% c(1900, 1950)){ world_adj <- subset(world, iso3 != "CZE" & iso3 != "SVK") world_adj <- bind_rows(world_adj, specials[specials$iso3 %in% c("CSK"),]) } if(input$year == 2000){ world_adj <- world } world_merged <- world_adj %>% left_join(gdp_year, by = c("iso3" = "location")) pal <- colorNumeric(palette = colorRampPalette(c("#DCEDC8", "#064300"))(100), domain = log10(range(gdp_year$GDPpc, na.rm = TRUE)), na.color = "transparent") legend_values <- seq(min(gdp_year$GDPpc, na.rm = TRUE), max(gdp_year$GDPpc, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 5) legend_labels <- format(legend_values, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE) legend_pal <- colorNumeric(palette = colorRampPalette(c("#DCEDC8", "#064300"))(100), domain = log10(legend_values), na.color = "transparent") leafletProxy("map", data = world_merged) %>% clearShapes() %>% clearControls() %>% addPolygons(data = world_merged, fillColor = ~pal(log_GDPpc), fillOpacity = ~ifelse(is.na(GDPpc), 0, 1), color = "black", weight = 0.8, popup = ~paste("Country:", name, "
", "GDP per Capita:", GDPpc, "
", "Year:", year, "
", "Source:", flag)) %>% addLegend(pal = legend_pal, values = log10(legend_values), labels = legend_labels, labFormat = labelFormat(transform = function(x) round(10^x, digits = 0)), title = "GDP per capita (2011$)", position = "bottomright") } # Observe the toggle button and re-render the map accordingly observeEvent(input$toggle_map, { if (map_state() == "regional") { map_state("country") updateActionButton(session, "toggle_map", label = "Switch to Regional Map") } else { map_state("regional") updateActionButton(session, "toggle_map", label = "Switch to Country Map") } render_map() }) # Observe year changes and re-render the map accordingly observeEvent(input$year, { req(input$year) render_map() }, ignoreInit = FALSE) # Ensures that the event is triggered on app initialization output$map <- renderLeaflet({ # leaflet() %>% # addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.PositronNoLabels) %>% # setView(lng = 10, lat = 50, zoom = 4) gdp_year <- gdpdata %>% filter(year == 1750) %>% mutate(log_GDPpc = log10(GDPpc)) contEurope_merged <- contEurope %>% left_join(gdp_year, by = c("NUTS_ID" = "location")) USAMSA_merged <- USAMSA %>% left_join(gdp_year, by = c("GEOID" = "location")) CAN_merged <- CAN %>% left_join(gdp_year, by = c("CMAUID" = "location")) pal <- colorNumeric(palette = colorRampPalette(c("#DCEDC8", "#064300"))(100), domain = log10(range(gdp_year$GDPpc, na.rm = TRUE)), na.color = "transparent") legend_values <- seq(min(gdp_year$GDPpc, na.rm = TRUE), max(gdp_year$GDPpc, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 5) legend_labels <- format(legend_values, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE) legend_pal <- colorNumeric(palette = colorRampPalette(c("#DCEDC8", "#064300"))(100), domain = log10(legend_values), na.color = "transparent") leaflet() %>% addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.PositronNoLabels) %>% setView(lng = 10, lat = 50, zoom = 4) %>% addPolygons(data = contEurope_merged, fillColor = ~pal(log_GDPpc), fillOpacity = ~ifelse(is.na(GDPpc), 0, 1), color = "black", weight = 0.8, popup = ~paste("Location Name:", NUTS_NAME, "
", "Location ID:", NUTS_ID, "
", "GDP per Capita:", GDPpc, "
", "Year:", year, "
", "Source:", flag)) %>% addPolygons(data = USAMSA_merged, fillColor = ~pal(log_GDPpc), fillOpacity = ~ifelse(is.na(GDPpc), 0, 1), color = "black", weight = 0.8, popup = ~paste("Location Name:", NAME, "
", "Location ID:", GEOID, "
", "GDP per Capita:", GDPpc, "
", "Year:", year, "
", "Source:", flag)) %>% addPolygons(data = CAN_merged, fillColor = ~pal(log_GDPpc), fillOpacity = ~ifelse(is.na(GDPpc), 0, 1), color = "black", weight = 0.8, popup = ~paste("Location Name:", CMANAME, "
", "Location ID:", CMAUID, "
", "GDP per Capita:", GDPpc, "
", "Year:", year, "
", "Source:", flag)) %>% addLegend(pal = legend_pal, values = log10(legend_values), labels = legend_labels, labFormat = labelFormat(transform = function(x) round(10^x, digits = 0)), title = "GDP per capita (2011$)", position = "bottomright") }) # Initial map render observe({ render_map() }) observeEvent(input$focus_europe, { leafletProxy("map") %>% setView(lng = 10, lat = 50, zoom = 4) }) observeEvent(input$focus_north_america, { leafletProxy("map") %>% setView(lng = -100, lat = 40, zoom = 4) }) output$data <- renderDT({ datatable(filtered_data() %>% arrange(desc(GDPpc)) %>% select(location, location_name, year, GDPpc, flag, GDPpc_lower, GDPpc_upper), options = list(order = list(list(3, 'desc')))) }) observeEvent(input$plot, { req(input$regions) plot_data <- gdpdata %>% filter(full_location_name %in% input$regions) # Ensure that the line plot is rendered when the button is pressed output$linePlot <- renderPlotly({ p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = year, y = GDPpc, color = full_location_name)) + geom_line() + geom_point(aes(text = paste("Location:", full_location_name, "
Year:", year, "
GDP per Capita:", GDPpc, "
Source:", flag))) + labs(x = "Year", y = "GDP per Capita (2011$)") + scale_y_continuous(trans = 'log', breaks = c(1000, 2000, 3000, 5000, 10000, 25000, 50000)) + scale_color_discrete(name="") + theme_minimal() ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") %>% layout(legend = list(orientation = "h", # horizontal legend x = 0.5, # centered xanchor = "center", # center the legend horizontally y = -0.2)) # move legend below the plot }) # Switch to the "Line Plot" tab when the plot button is clicked updateTabsetPanel(session, "mainTabset", selected = "Line Plot") }) } shinyApp(ui, server)
